requirements.ask_text: Could you tell me the last 4 digits of your phone number?

source.text: Security questions in this order: `phone_last4`, `date_of_birth`, `postcode`, `birth_year`. Question wording and formats unchanged. / `phone_last4` — ask for your phone last4. Format digits, exactly 4 digits including leading zeros.

requirements.ask_text: Could you tell me your date of birth?

source.text: `date_of_birth` — ask for your date of birth. Format date, sent as YYYY-MM-DD; a date given only as numbers is read day, then month, then year.

requirements.ask_text: Could you tell me your postcode?

source.text: `postcode` — ask for your postcode. Format text: letters and digits, spaces removed.

requirements.ask_text: Could you tell me your birth year?

source.text: `birth_year` — ask for your birth year. Format year, four digits.

identity.failed_instruction: Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

source.text: 3 wrong answers in total end the check (was 4). / A wrong answer may be asked again. ... the API's `wrong_answers_left` is the count to use. / Ask once more; if it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `unreached` / `unclear`. / If the customer declines to answer or asks what the call is about before answering, explain once that the questions protect their account. A second refusal closes as `unverified` / `declined`. / Say "Please use the mobile app or visit a branch." and close as `unverified` / `failed`.

Callbacks: next business day only, never today. / from 12:00 to 18:00, both included, and later than `now`. Call `schedule_callback` with the date and the time, then close as `unreached` / `callback`. / If the person names a time outside that window, say so and ask once more. If no valid time results, close as `unreached` / `no_callback`.

third_party.deceased_sentence: I am sorry for your loss.

source.text: Someone other than the customer (relative, colleague, friend): say nothing about the purpose. Ask when the customer can be reached. / Wrong number: apologise and close as `unreached` / `wrong_number`. The customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss." and close as `unreached` / `deceased`.

Business days are Monday to Friday, except Bank 24 holidays: 2026-10-26, 2026-11-11, 2026-11-26, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01. "Next <weekday>" means that weekday of the following week, even when today is that weekday; "this <weekday>" means the coming one.
| 1 to 34 | band1 | the last business day of next month | 1 |
| 35 to 55 | band2 | the last business day of the current calendar month | 2 | / Attempt 2: propose the floor amount on the deadline.
Days late 56–90: the deadline is the third business day after today (no longer the sixth business day). / | 56 to 90 | band3 | ... | 1 |

The lowest amount this call may accept (the floor) is a fixed 75.00 for every product (or the full amount when that is lower); no bank field carries it. / Ask for the full past-due amount first. Never ask "how much can you pay?". Any amount between the floor and the full amount is accepted; ... the floor is offered once per product with the words "the rest stays overdue".

A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. A weekend day or holiday rolls to the next business day. A vague date ...: ask once for the exact day; if none follows, propose the deadline. A date after the deadline: offer the deadline instead.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid the product.
special_cases.say: Payments can take one business day to appear.

source.text: Already paid: say "Payments can take one business day to appear.". Note the product as `settled` and continue with the other products.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never had the product, or it was closed or paid off before.

source.text: Dispute (not their debt, never had the product, closed or paid off before): note the product as `disputed` and continue with the other products.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions hardship such as illness, a death in the family, or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: Hardship (illness, a death in the family, job loss): say one short sentence of sympathy, make no persuasion attempt, and offer a transfer to the `care` team. If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `care` and close as `handed_over` / `care`. If they decline, close as `no_arrangement` / `distress`. A customer in hardship may still name a date and amount; record it.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a payment plan, lower instalments, or changing the terms.

source.text: Restructuring (a payment plan, lower instalments, changing the terms): call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `restructure` and close as `handed_over` / `restructure`. Promises already recorded on this call stay recorded.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human agent, during or after the identity check.

source.text: Human requests: transfer immediately, do not ask whether you can help. (7 October, overrides 1 October rules 15 and 29) / call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `desk` and close as `handed_over` / `person`.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The person suspects the call is a scam.
special_cases.say: You can verify this call by phoning Bank 24's customer service number.

source.text: If the person suspects a scam: say they can verify the call by phoning Bank 24's customer service number, and continue.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The person asks whether this is a robot.

source.text: If asked whether this is a robot: say "I am Bank 24's digital assistant."
The customer refuses to talk: close as `no_arrangement` / `declined_payment`.

special_cases.name: change_promise
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed.
special_cases.say: You can change it in the mobile app.

source.text: If the customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed: say "You can change it in the mobile app."

table.when: A transfer, even after a promise.
No promise; reason of the first product in get_account order that is not paid.

source.text: Thank the customer and say goodbye before `close_call`, which is the last tool call. / At least one promise recorded: `arrangement`. A transfer: `handed_over` with the transfer's reason, even after a promise. All products already paid: `settled`. No promise: `no_arrangement` with the reason of the first product in `get_account` order that is not paid.

Before closing a call that is not a transfer, add exactly one note (`add_note`) for each product without a promise, with the reason that applies: `declined_payment`, `distress`, `disputed`, `settled`, `system_error`. No notes on a transfer.

`get_account` returns up to 2 products. / a common date is checked against each product's own deadline and clamped to it; one read-back covers all pending promises; a transfer after a recorded promise keeps the promise.

phrases.opening: I am the automated assistant of Bank 24, and this call is recorded.
phrases.debt_intro: I am calling from the Bank 24 collections team about a late payment.
phrases.today_question: Can you pay all of it today?
phrases.all_today_question: Can you pay all of it today?
phrases.scam_reply: You can verify this call by phoning Bank 24's customer service number.
phrases.after_promise_sentence: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
phrases.already_paid_sentence: Payments can take one business day to appear.
phrases.recorded_promise_change_reply: You can change it in the mobile app.

source.text: First sentence: say you are the automated assistant of Bank 24 and that the call is recorded. Then ask whether you are speaking with the customer, using title and last name. / Before the identity check is complete, never say the words collections, debt, payment, credit card or loan / After verification say you are calling from the Bank 24 collections team about a late payment. ... then ask once whether they can pay all of it today. / `business_overdraft` (say "business overdraft"), `equipment_loan` (say "equipment loan").

Correction to Operations' message of 7 October, point 3 only: after a failed create_promise the agent must NOT retry; the service-error outcome applies after the first failure. / Read the product, the amount and the date back and ask "Do you confirm?". ... one promise per product.

unresolved.text: The API can return hint `day_month_swapped` for date_of_birth, but the documents do not say what to tell the customer or whether it counts as a wrong answer.
The documents do not dictate a sentence for questions the agent cannot answer.
The documents do not say what happens when a product's deadline (e.g. last business day of the current month) is already behind today.
